script: Welcome to the Digital Career Course. This course is for women who work from home, who have a phone or a computer, and who want to earn from digital work in the hours they can spare. You do not need a degree. You do not need to pay for expensive software. Everything in this course uses free tools that you can start with today. By the end of the thirteen chapters, you will have chosen one digital skill, built a small portfolio of sample work, set up your online profiles, and found your first client. You will also know how to price your work, send an invoice, get paid, and protect yourself from scams. Each video in this series covers one chapter. Watch the video once to understand it. Then open the matching chapter in the course book and do the exercises. The skills build on each other, so please do not skip ahead.
glossary: Canva, WhatsApp Business, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Upwork, Fiverr, LinkedIn, CapCut, Payoneer, OTP, PIN, freelance, Facebook, Instagram
